data.reference_assembly: complete_prompt + canonical_solution; host AST parsing only, execution inside original native sandbox

limitations: Reference outcomes diagnose this original environment and canonical implementation only, not a model accuracy or Skill-effect improvement.
A reference failure does not prove every model failure on that task was environmental; original P/F/U remain unchanged.
Reference pass does not certify arbitrary alternative implementations, resources or runtime behavior.
Five explicit missing-NLTK-resource reference failures motivate a new pinned data-only image; no updated-image result is included here.
Task-required network access and a read-only-filesystem failure are separate sandbox limitations, not permission to enable network or loosen isolation.
The 65 training tasks and 64 selection tasks are marked development exposure; the other271 tasks are not an independent final holdout for this study.
No private tests, canonical code, model responses, task text, keys or raw traceback were exported into this summary or sent to an LLM updater/Research module.
